messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Ananya Iyer
Chennai | ananya.iyer@example.com | github.com/ananya-dev

OBJECTIVE
Final-year computer science student seeking a software engineering internship.

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, expected 2025, CGPA 9.1
Relevant coursework: Operating Systems, DBMS, Computer Networks, Compiler Design

PROJECTS
CampusCart: a MERN stack marketplace for students to sell used books, with JWT auth and Stripe payments.
PathFinder Visualizer: an interactive visualizer for Dijkstra and A* search built with React and Canvas.
TinyDB: a key-value store in C++ with a write-ahead log and LSM-tree compaction.

INTERNSHIP
Software Engineering Intern, Freshworks (Summer 2024)
Added CSV bulk import to the CRM contacts module and wrote unit tests with Jest.

ACHIEVEMENTS
LeetCode Knight, rating 1950, 600+ problems solved
Codeforces Specialist
Smart India Hackathon 2023 finalist

SKILLS
C++, Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Git

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
